HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Vihaar in Africa.
   B. Say Buddhist Vihaar in Africa has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Buddhist Vihaar in Africa to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. Which response best shows understanding of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7..
   D. Say Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues ? (1 mark)

   D. Apply the teaching of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Communal aspects of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Use Communal aspects of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Communal aspects of Yoga has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communal aspects of Yoga.
   D. Apply the teaching of Communal aspects of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number.
   B. Use Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Managing Resources:? (1 mark)

11. Which response best shows understanding of Utsav from other faiths? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsav from other faiths.
   B. Use Utsav from other faiths to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Utsav from other faiths has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Utsav from other faiths with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism.
   B. Apply the teaching of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Utsav from other faiths; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
